SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRSSAN0028' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND (RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' OR RQDT.RECV_FLAG = 'GD') ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.REVISION , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = QTDT.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG FROM KEPRQDT RQDT, KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = $G_RS.REVISION$ AND RQDT.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = QTDT.QUOTATION_NO AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ= QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND RQDT.REVISION = QTDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE <> 0 ORDER BY RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC , AGENT_NAME
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = $G_RS.REVISION$
